author: scikit-plots
description: Identify concrete limitations, uncertainties, missing evidence, and unresolved questions.
empty_message: No one has generated a list of knowledge gaps for this topic yet.
instruction:
Review this topic and its available sources as a research analyst. Produce one clear list of knowledge gaps, limitations, uncertainties, and unresolved questions.

- Focus on what is missing, weakly supported, disputed, unmeasured, or outside the current evidence.
- Separate a true evidence gap from a source that simply was not included.
- Make each item concrete enough that a researcher or practitioner could investigate it.
- Prefer concise bullets and avoid repeating the topic summary.
- Do not claim a gap unless the available sources support that interpretation or clearly label it as an inference.
title: Knowledge Gaps
